Licence Renewal Tracking Software Guide (2026) | ExpiryEdge

# Licence Renewal Tracking Software: A Practical Buyer's Guide

The word "licence" hides at least six different things. Business licences. Professional licences. Federal registrations. Software ELAs. Vehicle and equipment certifications. Trade and industry certifications. If your business touches three or more, a spreadsheet will eventually fail you. Here's what to look for and which tools handle it well.

Updated 2026 · 8 min read · Written by the ExpiryEdge team.

#### What "licence" actually means in your business

Before you pick software, get clear on which of these you're tracking. Most businesses touch three or four.

###### Business licences & permits

General operating licences, sales tax permits, food service permits, liquor licences. Annual is most common; many run 1-4 year cycles (SBA, 2025).

###### Professional licences

Doctor, nurse, attorney, accountant, real estate agent, contractor, engineer, electrician. Issued by state boards; 1-3 year cycles.

###### Federal registrations

DEA registration (3-year cycle), FCC licences, FAA certifications, FMCSA operating authority. Each on its own clock.

###### Software licences

Per-seat SaaS, perpetual licences with annual support, enterprise licence agreements with true-up cycles.

###### Vehicle & equipment licences

Fleet registrations, DOT numbers, equipment certifications.

###### Trade & industry certifications

ISO, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP. Multi-year cycles with continuous monitoring.

Sources: U.S. Small Business Administration, Mosey on renewal frequencies, DEA Diversion Control.

###### What's the difference between a renewal date and a renewal action deadline?

The renewal date is when the licence expires. The action deadline is when you have to start the renewal work - earlier, sometimes by months. A state licence that expires June 30 with a 90-day processing window has a real action deadline of April 1, not June 30. Good software calculates and alerts on the action deadline.

###### What happens if a licence lapses entirely?

It depends on the licence. Late fees are common ($50 to $5,000+). Some lapses force a fresh application - 60 to 120 days for many states. For professional licences, practising while lapsed is usually a misdemeanour. For business operations, lapsed permits can void contracts and expose officers to personal liability.

###### How should auto-renewing software licences be tracked?

Track the notice deadline, not the renewal date. Notice windows of 30, 60 and 90 days are all common in B2B SaaS, and the one that binds you is whatever your contract specifies. Miss that window and the contract auto-renews, often at a higher price. Configure alerts to fire at least 30 days before the notice deadline - not before the renewal date.

###### How do we choose between tracking-only and a filing service?

Tracking-only is cheaper and assumes you'll do the actual filing. Filing services (Harbor Compliance, Mosey for some filings, CertifyOS for clinician licensing) cost more per renewal but save staff time. Break-even depends on your compliance team's capacity. Most mid-market businesses do better with tracking software plus selective filing services for the highest-volume categories.
